name: Dented Lantern
description: A portable, dented lantern carried by Kell into the community radio studio during an emergency. Later used by Aria on the water tower catwalk to provide light and braced with her boot to stabilize equipment during high winds.
narrative_significance: Functional emergency equipment essential to the radio team's disaster response operation. The lantern serves as both a practical light source during the power outage and a symbol of the team's resourcefulness in maintaining communication infrastructure when conventional systems have failed.
